name: Gate to the Afterlife
description: The gate that opens fully at the Hours, revealing the Necropolis rather than paradise.

pages_say.description: The gate promised to open when the second sun sits between the horns.
A massive stone barrier where the Luxa meets the Hekma, which opens at the Hours to reveal endless wastes.
The gate opened at the Hours, atop which Razaketh stood.
The gate that opens fully at the Hours, revealing the Necropolis rather than paradise.
The gate that opened onto wastes and unleashed horrors; the scarab god stands before it.
The gate from the direction of which a sandstorm sweeps in.
